findings.summary: Auditor said (A.4) is unstated for M and J. That is wrong: OutgoingDilation states all five factors and the H relation under X = XR·x, for the constructed outgoing profile, with C_p in tail form.

The U₀=0 clause (three E-corrections prescribe I, S, C_p and preserve M, J) is not one theorem. It follows from exists_normalized_repair at G=0, and TerminalCompensation states it for α = −1/2−λ, λ ≥ 0, including α = −1/2.

Lean proves invertibility for one fixed bump family: U-bumps on the left half of the patch, E-bumps on the right half. So u·e = 0 and the δU·δE cross term in J vanishes. The paper allows any Lemma A.1 families.
